title: FeatureArc: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Evolving Features
abstract: arXiv:2610.37434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A software feature usually evolves over time: developers extend its first version as new use cases and requirements arrive, and each extension builds on code written earlier. Most feature benchmarks evaluate a single request on a fixed codebase. Feature evolution requires evaluating successive extensions on an agent's own earlier code and checking whether the feature remains correct. We introduce FeatureArc to evaluate coding agents on evolving features, together with a pipeline that constructs its tasks from repository histories. The benchmark combines dependencies between successive stages of the same feature, explicit requirements and interface contracts, and executable checks across four programming languages. The pipeline validates fail-to-pass (F2P) tests for new behavior and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests for existing behavior on the reference code before and after each stage. We evaluated 10 coding agents on 73 manually reviewed task

translated_title: FeatureArc：在演化特性上对编码智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 一个软件特性通常会随时间演化：随着新用例和需求的到来，开发人员会在第一版的基础上进行扩展，而每次扩展都建立在之前编写的代码之上。大多数特性基准测试是在固定代码库上评估单个请求。特性演化则要求在智能体自己先前编写的代码上评估连续的扩展，并检查该特性是否保持正确。我们提出了 FeatureArc，用于评估编码智能体在演化特性上的表现，并配备了一个从仓库历史构建任务的流水线。该基准测试结合了同一特性各连续阶段之间的依赖关系、明确的需求与接口契约，以及覆盖四种编程语言的可执行检查。该流水线在参考代码的每个阶段前后，验证针对新行为的“失败到通过”（F2P）测试和针对既有行为的“通过到通过”（P2P）测试。我们在 73 个经人工审核的任务上评估了 10 个编码智能体。
tldr: 提出 FeatureArc 基准测试，首次评估编码智能体在软件特性持续演化场景下的能力，其流水线从仓库历史构建包含阶段间依赖、明确需求契约、可执行 F2P/P2P 测试验证并覆盖四种编程语言的任务。
en_tdlr: FeatureArc introduces a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on evolving software features, with a pipeline that constructs tasks from repository histories, combining inter-stage dependencies, explicit requirements and interface contracts, and executable F2P/P2P test validation across four programming languages.
